$comment: License catalog for the license optimization report. SKU names and part numbers are NOT stored here: Config/ConversionTable.csv (the shipped Microsoft SKU list) is the single SKU database and products are keyed by its GUID. Each product carries: prices = public per-user/month list price on an annual commitment per ISO currency (Update-LicensePricingDefaults.ps1 refreshes them from Microsoft); family/tier = position on the product ladder; eligibleTarget=false = never recommended outside its own family (frontline terms, regional no-Teams variants, add-ons). capabilities map plain-language features to service plan ids so any SKU can be compared.

meta.currencyNote: Prices are per user per month with an annual commitment, in the currency listed.
meta.upliftNote: Microsoft NCE month-to-month subscriptions cost 20% more than an annual commitment. Used to value moving stable seats to annual terms.

priceSources.CAD: Microsoft public list price where published; otherwise Sherweb SRP price list 2026-09-19 (yearly commitment / 12), matched to the SKU list by product name
priceSources.EUR: Microsoft public list price where published; otherwise CAD list price x 0,6388, the median EUR/CAD ratio across the 45 SKUs Microsoft prices in both currencies (2026-09-19)
priceSources.USD: Microsoft public list price where published; otherwise CAD list price x 0,7366, the median USD/CAD ratio across the 48 SKUs Microsoft prices in both currencies (2026-09-19)
